q: What is the Coimbatore air compressor cluster's energy use and carbon footprint?
title: Coimbatore compressor cluster: energy, CO2
short: About 2,255 toe and roughly 9,600 t CO2 a year across some 300 units in 2017-18. The 100 assemblers use only electricity, about 50 kWh per compressor. The 200 component makers also burn LPG and diesel, and that fuel, not machining, is over 80% of a typical component unit's CO2.
audience: Reciprocating air compressor makers and their component suppliers in Peelamedu and Pappanaickenpalayam

ul: 100 assemblers build about 57,000 reciprocating compressors a year: 10 medium units at about 250 a month, 60 small at 30, 30 micro at 15.
Small units build up to 5 hp, medium units up to 20 hp. None of the MSMEs makes screw compressors.
200 component makers supply foundation plates, engine cases, pistons, air receivers, sheet metal parts and connecting rods; castings and forgings come from the city's foundries and forges.
Machining takes about 80% of a unit's electricity, welding 10% and the shop's own air compressors 5 to 10%.
Component units cure paint in LPG or diesel ovens at about 200 C, 500 kg to 5 t a batch for 45 to 60 minutes. Ovens are often oversized and run part empty.
Diesel also runs DG sets in the rare power cuts.

sections.h: Most of a compressor's footprint is bought in
p: An assembler's own power is about 34 kg CO2 per compressor. The castings, steel and motor in it weigh far more in a product figure. Those are Scope 3 purchased goods: ask each supplier for a per kg or per part figure and keep the reply with the order.

ul: Insulate paint ovens and cut the heated volume to match the load.
Cogged V-belts at 95 to 98% transmission efficiency, against 90 to 92% for flat belts.
IE3 motors on lathes and honing machines, and plugged air leaks.

example.title: Unit and cluster figures (estimate)
lines: Assembler: 28,800 kWh x 0.675 = 19.4 t CO2 a year
Per compressor: 2.88 million kWh / 57,000 = 50.5 kWh x 0.675 = 34 kg CO2
Component unit: 26,000 kWh = 17.6 t; 16,364 kg LPG x 2.98 = 48.8 t; 13,043 L diesel x 2.645 = 34.5 t; total 100.9 t
Cluster: 8.08 million kWh = 5,454 t; 818 t LPG = 2,438 t; 652 kL diesel = 1,725 t; about 9,600 t
example.note: Energy and output from TERI's 2017-18 cluster energy profile; factors from CEA and IPCC. Castings, steel and motors bought in are not included.
